title: SpaceTraders markets
description: The markets and shipyards the SpaceTraders bot has cached, per system, and the game's production chains (Gemberkoekje/projects SpaceTraders/PLAN.md 2.8).

list.name: reset_date
list.label: Reset
list.description: The server reset whose run the dashboard shows, newest first (slice 2.13): every series carries it as reset_date and every log line as ResetDate, so runs never mix. Tick several to compare runs. Data from before slice 2.13 has no reset date and shows under none.

panels.title: Markets

targets.expr: count(spacetraders_market_observed_timestamp_seconds{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})

panels.description: Markets the bot knows in this system.

panels.title: Markets with prices

targets.expr: count(count by (waypoint) (spacetraders_market_purchase_price{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", reset_date=~"$reset_date"}))

panels.description: Markets a ship has been at, so their prices are known.

panels.title: Shipyards

targets.expr: count(spacetraders_shipyard_observed_timestamp_seconds{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})

panels.description: Shipyards the bot knows in this system.

panels.title: Oldest market data

targets.expr: time() - min(spacetraders_market_observed_timestamp_seconds{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})

panels.description: How long ago the least recently refreshed market in this system was refreshed. Prices are as last seen.

panels.title: Places

targets.expr: max by (waypoint, waypoint_type) (time() - spacetraders_market_observed_timestamp_seconds{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", waypoint=~"$waypoint", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})
max by (waypoint, waypoint_type) (time() - spacetraders_shipyard_observed_timestamp_seconds{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", waypoint=~"$waypoint", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})
count by (waypoint) (spacetraders_market_purchase_price{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", waypoint=~"$waypoint", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})

panels.description: The markets and shipyards in this system: the waypoint's type, how long ago the bot refreshed each, and how many goods have prices (none until a ship has been there).

panels.title: Shipyards

targets.expr: max by (waypoint, ship_type) (spacetraders_shipyard_ship_type{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", waypoint=~"$waypoint", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})
max by (waypoint, ship_type) (spacetraders_shipyard_ship_price{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", waypoint=~"$waypoint", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})
max by (waypoint, ship_type) (spacetraders_shipyard_ship_supply{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", waypoint=~"$waypoint", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})
max by (waypoint, ship_type) (spacetraders_shipyard_ship_fuel_capacity_units{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", waypoint=~"$waypoint", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})
max by (waypoint, ship_type) (spacetraders_shipyard_ship_cargo_capacity_units{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", waypoint=~"$waypoint", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})
max by (waypoint, ship_type, can, equipment) (spacetraders_shipyard_ship_info{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", waypoint=~"$waypoint", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})

panels.description: Ship types per shipyard, as last seen; the details are empty until a ship has been there. Can do: what the ship could do in the fleet, judged as the fleet table's "can do" judges a ship: by its mounts, hold and tank, whichever plans are on (Survey, Mine, Siphon, Trade, Construct: build the home system's jump gate; none for a ship that can do none of them), but Probe for a probe, which the probe plan buys and flies. Price and supply: what the shipyard asks, and its supply. Fuel: what the tank holds. Cargo: what the holds take together. Equipment: its mounts, then its modules, without the MOUNT_ and MODULE_ prefixes, and without the cargo holds (cargo shows them) and crew quarters.

panels.title: Trade goods

targets.expr: max by (waypoint, good, kind) (spacetraders_market_purchase_price{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", waypoint=~"$waypoint", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})
max by (waypoint, good, kind) (spacetraders_market_sell_price{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", waypoint=~"$waypoint", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})
max by (waypoint, good, kind) (spacetraders_market_trade_volume{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", waypoint=~"$waypoint", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})
max by (waypoint, good, kind) (spacetraders_market_supply{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", waypoint=~"$waypoint", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})
max by (waypoint, good, kind) (spacetraders_market_activity{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", waypoint=~"$waypoint", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})

panels.description: Every good at every market in this system, as last seen. Buy price: what the market charges you; sell price: what it pays you. Kind: EXPORT (the market makes it), IMPORT (it consumes it), EXCHANGE (it only trades it). Volume: units per transaction before the price moves. Sorted by good, so the markets for one good are together.

panels.title: Prices of $good

targets.expr: max by (waypoint) (spacetraders_market_purchase_price{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", good="$good", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})
max by (waypoint) (spacetraders_market_sell_price{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", good="$good", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})

panels.description: The chosen good's buy and sell price at each market in this system over time. A price only changes when a ship refreshes the market, so the lines move in steps.

panels.title: Market tree: goods traded in $system

targets.expr: max by (good, made_from, used_for) (spacetraders_good_supply_chain{namespace="spacetraders", reset_date=~"$reset_date"}) * on (good) group_left () (max by (good) (spacetraders_market_purchase_price{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", reset_date=~"$reset_date"}) * 0 + 1)

max by (good, buy_at) (label_replace(bottomk by (good) (1, spacetraders_market_purchase_price{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", reset_date=~"$reset_date"} > 0), "buy_at", "$1", "waypoint", "(.*)"))

max by (good, sell_at) (label_replace(topk by (good) (1, spacetraders_market_sell_price{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", reset_date=~"$reset_date"} > 0), "sell_at", "$1", "waypoint", "(.*)"))

max by (good) (spacetraders_market_sell_price{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", reset_date=~"$reset_date"} > 0) - min by (good) (spacetraders_market_purchase_price{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", reset_date=~"$reset_date"} > 0)

max by (good) (spacetraders_market_trade_volume{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", reset_date=~"$reset_date"} and on (good, waypoint, reset_date) bottomk by (good) (1, spacetraders_market_purchase_price{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", reset_date=~"$reset_date"} > 0))

max by (good) (spacetraders_market_trade_volume{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", reset_date=~"$reset_date"} and on (good, waypoint, reset_date) topk by (good) (1, spacetraders_market_sell_price{namespace="spacetraders", system="$system", reset_date=~"$reset_date"} > 0))

panels.description: The game's production chains for every good with a price in this system: what it is made from, and what is made from it. Raw goods are made from nothing (the game lists MACHINERY for some extracted goods). Then where it is cheapest to buy and where it sells best, at the prices last seen, each with its trade volume: the most units one purchase or one sale at that market takes. The difference is what a unit earns before fuel; at 0 or below no market pays more than another charges. A trader buys a full hold in one purchase and sells it in one sale (D56), so the pair shown here is traded only when both volumes are at least the trader's free hold, or when the seller's supply is ABUNDANT (see Trade goods): then it carries the smaller volume, still in one purchase and one sale (D74). Another pair, with a smaller difference, may be traded instead. Which routes the bot trades, and in what order, is in the table below; why it doesn't trade the other goods with a price gap, in the one under it.

panels.title: Trade routes, in the order traders take them
panels.description: The bot's own order: the trading plan's routes as its last pass with a free trader stored them (the bot's /status/trading-routes, through the SpaceTraders API data source, across every system its traders are in). First the routes traders hold, with the trader. Then the lucrative routes no trader holds, numbered best first: the order the plan hands routes out in, each to the free trader it suits best. How the plan ranks, for each free trader: every route from where the trader stands that earns at least Trade.MinProfitPerUnit a unit after the fuel for the whole trip (D14); its units are a full hold bought and sold at once, or, where the seller's supply is ABUNDANT, what both markets trade at once (D56, D74); the credits no other trip holds back must pay for them (D57). Among those, a route whose sell market makes a pricier good from the cargo (feeds) comes first (D15), then the most profit after fuel. Two traders never share a route (D18). A waiting route shows the figures of the trader it suits best, and at most 20 are listed, only from a pass when a trader was free; a held route keeps the figures it was chosen with. Could take it: the free traders it was lucrative for. As of: when the plan last changed this list. Why the other goods with a price gap aren't traded: the table below.

defaults.noValue: No routes: no trader holds one, and none waited at the trading plan's last pass

panels.title: Goods not traded, and why
panels.description: Each good with a price gap (a market in the system sells it for less than another pays for it) that no route in the table above carries, and why the trading plan doesn't trade it (D76): the first of its checks the good's route failed, for the free trader that got furthest with it, then the route with the largest price gap. The checks, in their order (the bot's /status/trading-routes, as TradeRoutePlanner.Rank runs them): the buy market in reach from where the trader is, refuelling at markets on the way; the sell market in reach from there; a full hold in one purchase and one sale, or, where the seller's supply is ABUNDANT, what both markets trade at once (D56, D74); the credits free for cargo pay for it with the trip's fuel (D56); at least Trade.MinProfitPerUnit a unit after fuel (D14). Below the listed routes: lucrative, but the 20 waiting routes the plan keeps rank higher. Why not: that check in a sentence, with the trader first and the figures. While every trader is on a trip the plan checks nothing, and the rows of its last pass with a free trader stay. As of: when that pass found it.

defaults.noValue: None: every good with a price gap is in the routes above, or no pass of the trading plan with a free trader has found one yet

panels.title: Market tree: all goods

targets.expr: max by (good, made_from, used_for) (spacetraders_good_supply_chain{namespace="spacetraders", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})

panels.description: Every good in the game's production chains: what it is made from, and what is made from it.

panels.title: What we sell into a market, and what it makes
panels.description: To see, over time, how many units of an input we sell to a market against what happens to the supply, trade volume and price of the goods it makes, since nobody knows how many units of input make one of output, or how fast. Pick the market at the top.

panels.title: Units we sold into $market per hour

targets.expr: sum by (good) (increase(spacetraders_goods_sold_units_total{namespace="spacetraders", waypoint="$market", reset_date=~"$reset_date"}[1h]))

panels.description: How many units of each good we sold to this market, per hour (each bar is one hour), to set against what happens to the supply, trade volume and price of the goods it makes, in the graphs to the right. Nobody knows how many units of input make one of output, or how fast; this shows it over time. Pick the market at the top.

panels.title: What $market makes: price

targets.expr: max by (good) (spacetraders_market_purchase_price{namespace="spacetraders", waypoint="$market", kind="EXPORT", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})

panels.description: The price this market charges for each good it makes (its exports), as last seen. It moves in steps, when a ship refreshes the market. Set against the units we sold into the market (left) to see what selling it inputs does to it.

panels.title: What $market makes: supply and trade volume

targets.expr: max by (good) (spacetraders_market_supply{namespace="spacetraders", waypoint="$market", kind="EXPORT", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})
max by (good) (spacetraders_market_trade_volume{namespace="spacetraders", waypoint="$market", kind="EXPORT", reset_date=~"$reset_date"})

panels.description: Supply (left axis, 1 SCARCE to 5 ABUNDANT) and trade volume (right axis: units per transaction before the price moves) of each good this market makes (its exports), as last seen. They move in steps, when a ship refreshes the market. Set against the units we sold into the market (far left) to see what selling it inputs does to them.
